Re: Expedited/standard appeal of denial of CPT 63030

Plan: Oklahoma Complete Health (Ambetter)  
Denial date: August 10, 2026  
Reference number: POC-4825AA1F8B-42990  

Dear Appeals and Grievances Department:

I appeal the denial of prior authorization for lumbar decompression/microdiscectomy, CPT 63030. The denial states that the submitted documentation was incomplete and did not permit a medical-necessity determination. The records below address the clinical information relevant to the requested procedure.

The clinical record establishes the following:

- I have had nine months of progressive low-back pain that has not been relieved by rest.
- I completed 14 weeks of supervised physical therapy, including core stabilization and lumbar flexibility, from April 13, 2026, through July 20, 2026. I completed 20 visits, as documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- I used NSAIDs for six months without adequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on May 18, 2026, provided only two weeks of partial relief.
- A lumbar MRI performed on July 5, 2026, showed an L4-L5 disc extrusion with severe right lateral recess stenosis and compression of the traversing L5 nerve root.
- I have radicular pain extending into the right calf and cannot stand for more than 10 minutes.
- Examination documented positive provocative testing on the affected side and a neurologic deficit corresponding to the imaged level.
- The requested surgery is being performed by Okafor, MD, an orthopedic surgeon.
- There is no active infection or untreated substance-use condition. I am a nonsmoker and have a BMI of 29.

The publicly available Evolent musculoskeletal-surgery guideline that applies during the date of this request states:

“All appropriate supporting documentation, including recent pertinent office visit notes, laboratory data, and results of any special testing must be provided.”

The submitted records include the relevant treatment history, physical-therapy discharge documentation, medication and injection history, MRI findings, functional limitations, examination findings, diagnosis, and proposed surgical treatment. If any specific document was not received or was considered insufficient, please identify that document precisely and allow its submission during the appeal.

The guideline also states:

“In order for surgeries to be considered medically necessary there must be clear medical records that demonstrate a clear surgical plan that matches the request for surgery.”

The request is for CPT 63030, and the clinical findings identify a single-level L4-L5 disc extrusion causing severe right lateral recess stenosis and compression of the traversing L5 nerve root. The symptoms, right-calf radicular pain, functional limitation, examination findings, neurologic deficit, MRI level, and requested lumbar decompression/microdiscectomy correspond to the same affected level and nerve root.

The guideline further states:

“Operative treatment is indicated only when the natural history of surgically treated lesions is better than the natural history for non-operatively treated lesions.”

In this case, symptoms have progressively continued for nine months despite extensive nonoperative treatment. I completed 20 supervised physical-therapy visits over 14 weeks, used NSAIDs for six months without adequate relief, and received only brief partial benefit from a corticosteroid injection. Continuing the same conservative treatment has not adequately relieved the symptoms or restored function.

The guideline also states:

“All operative interventions must be based on a positive correlation with clinical findings, the natural history of the disease, the clinical course, and diagnostic tests or imaging results.”

That correlation is documented here: progressive symptoms and functional impairment correspond with right-sided radicular pain; examination shows a corresponding neurologic deficit and positive provocative testing; and MRI demonstrates an L4-L5 disc extrusion with severe right lateral recess stenosis and compression of the traversing L5 nerve root.

Please conduct a complete appeal review using the enclosed records and approve prior authorization for CPT 63030. If the denial is upheld, please provide a detailed written explanation identifying each missing or insufficient record, the exact clinical criterion not met, the guideline version and criteria used, and the information required for approval.

Please also provide a copy of the complete clinical criteria applied to reference number POC-4825AA1F8B-42990, including any delegated-vendor criteria or checklist used by the reviewer.

Sincerely,

Morgan Foster
